attributes.name: Blessing of Tsukiyo
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to add 1 die to any check.

Discard this card to draw a weapon or an armor from your discard pile. 

Discard this card to explore your location.

After you play this card, if the top card of the blessings discard pile lists Charisma in its check to acquire, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
